messages:
Ivy R: ok tiny but blocking: the new onboarding sample fails tsc under ESM/nodenext. weird overload inference.
Ivy R: error: TS2769 No overload matches this call — one overload expects string|Buffer but inference produced unknown.
Omar S: nodenext will change conditional export/type resolution. what does your tsconfig look like?
Ivy R: minimal: { "module": "esnext", "moduleResolution": "nodenext", "target": "es2022", "lib": ["es2022", "dom"], "strict": true }
Juno K: is the SDK using overloads like request<T>(opts) + request(opts)? the compiler can pick a different signature depending on import resolution.
Ivy R: yes, and it's only when building for edge ESM. CJS builds are fine.
Omar S: quick mitigation: call with explicit generic or narrow the body before the call. but we should make SDK types resilient for both module systems.
Juno K: also flagging a runtime quirk: retries on auth failures in edge drop Authorization when the request body is a stream (body consumed). sample uses a streaming POST.
Ivy R: exactly, so reproduction requires both the typing and the retry fix.
Omar S: plan: (1) update SDK d.ts to make overloads unambiguous for callers (explicit generic entrypoint), (2) add CI compile job with moduleResolution=nodenext + esnext, (3) patch retry logic to clone headers/reattach auth when retrying streamed bodies.
Juno K: I'll take the types PR and add a tiny sample in examples/ that compiles both ways.
Omar S: I'll add an edge-worker integration to GH Actions to cover the retry header preservation.
ci-bot: queued: edge-compile-matrix job (esnext/nodenext) and edge-retry-integration :white_check_mark:
